description: Falsifiable predictions of the diagrammatic-double-magic / LR-fusion-rigidity conjecture for the seven double-magic isotopes on the magic ladder {2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126}. Records what the conjecture *predicts* (kappa_A = 0, dominant lambda_A self-conjugate, A on the magic ladder) without committing to specific Young-diagram row vectors — those are produced by a separate enumeration script (TBD).

axiomatised_components: ShellCondensationConjecture.collapse_iff_magic (the BB-stratum coincidence with the magic ladder)
DoubleMagicConjecture.lr_rigidity (LR-fusion preserves self-conjugacy at saturated inputs)

isotopes.name: He-4
isotopes.notes: Alpha-particle. Within Hoefsmit reach (k = 2). Empirically the most stable light nucleus.

isotopes.name: O-16
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic O-16. Within Hoefsmit reach. Self-conjugate partitions of 8 include [4, 2, 1, 1].

isotopes.name: Ca-40
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Ca-40. At the edge of Hoefsmit tractability (k = 10 boundary). delta^2 Phi peak +20.4 in shell-closure.witness.json corroborates.

isotopes.name: Ni-56
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Ni-56. Beyond Hoefsmit horizon (k = 14 > 10). The conjecture supplies the prediction; no matrix evaluation can verify.

isotopes.name: Sn-100
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Sn-100. Far beyond Hoefsmit horizon. Empirically observed; this is a structural pre-prediction of the homological framework.

isotopes.name: Pb-208
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Pb-208 (heaviest known stable doubly-magic). Both Z=82 and N=126 lie on the magic ladder; cross-shell LR-fusion. Way beyond matrix evaluation.

isotopes.name: magic-126-symmetric
isotopes.notes: Hypothetical Z=N=126 isotope (A=252 superheavy regime, not observed). Included only as a structural test: if the framework is correct, the heaviest magic number should still produce a kappa = 0, self-conjugate composite under LR-fusion.

validation_notes.kappa_A_zero_provenance: Provenance of kappa_A = 0: kappa_zero_of_self_conjugate (proved in QOU/BraidKnot/ShellNeutrality.lean for an arbitrary self-conjugate Young diagram in the abstract Multiset model) + content additivity (axiomatised typeclass field, derivable from the LR rule).
validation_notes.lambda_A_self_conjugacy_provenance: Provenance of lambda_A self-conjugate: DoubleMagicConjecture.lr_rigidity, axiomatised as a Lean typeclass field. Falsifiable by direct LR-coefficient computation at saturated inputs for any tractable case (k <= 10).
validation_notes.magic_ladder_membership: A in {4, 16, 40, 56, 100, 208, 252} for the listed cases. {4, 16, 40, 56, 100, 208} are observationally double-magic; A = 252 is hypothetical.
future_work: Enumerate self-conjugate partitions of each magic n via the bijection with partitions into distinct odd parts; record explicit row vectors for lambda_Z, lambda_N.
Compute LR coefficients numerically for the (lambda_Z, lambda_N) self-conjugate pairs at k <= 10 to test dominance of the predicted self-conjugate lambda_A.
Lean-formalise content additivity from a concrete Young-diagram model in Mathlib once Mathlib.Combinatorics.Young.YoungDiagram is wired into the QOU build.
